各位老师好，我是西南交通大学—利兹学院的黄俊凯，指导老师是黄德青教授。我的题目是“基于大模型的接触网领域智能问答系统研究”。本课题关注技术标准中的信息查询，希望回答能够追溯到正确版本和原文依据。下面我按照研究动机、技术方案、验证方法和可行性四个方面汇报。

English Script
Good morning, members of the panel. I am Junkai Huang from the SWJTU-Leeds Joint School, supervised by Professor Deqing Huang. My project is titled ‘A Study on a Large-Model-Based Intelligent Question-Answering System for the Overhead Contact System Field’. It focuses on standards queries, with answers traceable to the correct edition and source evidence. I will cover the motivation, method, evaluation and feasibility.

title: Background: standards consultation
chinese: 这张照片展示了铁路上方的接触网场景。围绕接触网部件开展学习和技术文档查询时，常常需要同时查找技术要求、试验方法和适用条件。这些信息可能分散在不同文件里，同一标准也可能存在不同版本。查询的难点因此不只是找到一句相关的话，而是确认它来自哪份文件、哪个版本，是否适用于当前问题。普通大模型即使表达流畅，也不一定能给出可核查的依据。本课题希望把文档检索与生成回答结合，让使用者能够从答案直接回到原文。本系统定位于学习与查询辅助，不用于铁路工程认证或实际运营决策。
english: This photograph shows the overhead-line setting above a railway. When learning about OCS components or consulting technical documents, users may need requirements, test methods, and applicability conditions from different files. A standard may also have several editions. Finding a relevant sentence is therefore only the beginning: users must establish which document and edition it comes from, and whether it applies to their question. A fluent model response does not necessarily provide that evidence. This project will connect retrieval with answer generation so users can follow an answer back to its source. Its scope is learning and consultation, not engineering certification or operational decisions.
source: 报告 pp.1–2，§1.1–1.3。照片：AlexHe34, Overhead-lines-railway.JPG, CC BY-SA 3.0；https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Overhead-lines-railway.JPG；https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/；原图未修改，仅等比缩放。
notes:
第4页 / Slide 4: Background: standards consultation
主讲参考时长 / Reference time: 40 s

中文逐字稿
接触网技术文档查询，不只是找到一个相关词。例如，学习者查到金具的技术要求后，可能还需要寻找相应试验方法，并确认使用的是哪个正式版本。左图仅说明接触网的真实场景，研究对象仍是文档中的信息。报告列举了 TB/T 2073-2020 和 TB/T 2074-2020 两类候选标准。关键词检索可能漏掉换一种说法的问题，而模型直接回答又可能遗漏单位、适用条件或版本信息。因此，我希望把文档检索与答案来源核对结合起来。系统用于学习和查询，不代替工程认证或运营决策。

English Script
Consulting overhead contact system documents involves more than finding a relevant term. After locating a fitting requirement, a learner may need its test method and formal edition. The photograph illustrates the physical context, while this study examines document information. The proposal identifies TB/T 2073-2020 and TB/T 2074-2020 as candidate standards. Keyword search may miss paraphrases, while direct model answers may omit units, conditions or editions. I therefore plan to combine retrieval with source checks. The system supports learning and consultation, not engineering approval or operational decisions.

来源 / Sources
报告 pp.1–2，§1.1–1.3。照片：AlexHe34, Overhead-lines-railway.JPG, CC BY-SA 3.0；https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Overhead-lines-railway.JPG；https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/；原图未修改，仅等比缩放。

title: Motivating example: an edition-specific query
chinese: 以这一查询为例，用户问的是某个部件在指定版本下有哪些试验要求。本页仅为示意，不引用真实标准条款或数值。如果模型直接凭已有知识回答，可能引用另一版本，也可能给出没有来源的内容，这就是需要研究的问题。目标系统将先核对文档与版本，再寻找相关证据；能够回答时提供原文位置，版本缺失或证据不足时拒答或澄清。RAG的价值就在于让回答建立在可检查的文档上，而不是只看它说得是否像正确答案。但引入RAG本身不保证可靠，因此还需要后面的对照实验。
english: Consider this query about test requirements for a fitting in a requested edition. It is an illustration, not a quotation of real clauses or values. A model answering from its existing knowledge could use another edition or provide unsupported content. The proposed system will check the document and edition, retrieve evidence, and provide a source location when answering. If the edition is missing or evidence is insufficient, it will refuse or ask for clarification. RAG makes the document basis inspectable rather than relying on a fluent response. However, RAG alone does not guarantee reliability, so controlled experiments are still needed.
source: 依据报告 §1.1、§4.3–4.4 改编的设计示意；标准 S、版本 A/B、金具 X 均为虚拟占位，不含真实条款、参数或年份适用关系。
notes:
第5页 / Slide 5: Motivating example: an edition-specific query
主讲参考时长 / Reference time: 50 s

中文逐字稿
这里是一个完全示意的查询，不对应真实标准条款，也不是一次实际模型测试。假设用户问：在指定版本中，金具 X 适用哪些试验要求？如果只得到一个流畅答案，却不知道它来自哪个版本，就很难判断是否可用。目标系统首先核对标准系列和版本；如果版本可用，就检索依据，并给出文件页码或段落位置。如果请求的版本缺失，就明确拒答；如果证据不足以支持问题，也不能补写一个听起来合理的要求。这个例子说明，我要研究的是答案的证据链，而不仅是语言是否通顺。

English Script
This query is entirely illustrative. It is neither a real standard clause nor an observed model test. Suppose a user asks which test requirements apply to fitting X in a specified edition. A fluent answer is difficult to assess without knowing its edition. The proposed system first checks the standard family and edition. If available, it retrieves evidence and provides a file-page or paragraph location. If the edition is missing, it refuses. If evidence is insufficient, it must not invent a plausible requirement. The focus is the answer’s evidence chain, beyond linguistic fluency.

来源 / Sources
依据报告 §1.1、§4.3–4.4 改编的设计示意；标准 S、版本 A/B、金具 X 均为虚拟占位，不含真实条款、参数或年份适用关系。

title: Research aim and three questions
chinese: 本研究围绕三个问题展开。RQ1：Hybrid能否比BM25和Dense提高证据召回；RQ2：版本过滤能否减少非指定版本答案；RQ3：Evidence Gate能否减少无依据回答，同时避免过度拒答。对应的是检索、版本控制和证据充分性三个层次。它们是拟验证的问题，不是已经证实的效果，也不涉及训练新的基础模型。
english: The study has three questions. RQ1 asks whether Hybrid improves evidence recall over BM25 and Dense. RQ2 asks whether edition filtering reduces answers from a non-requested edition. RQ3 asks whether an Evidence Gate reduces unsupported answers without excessive refusal. These address retrieval, edition control, and evidence sufficiency. They are questions to test, not established benefits, and the project does not train a new foundation model.
source: 报告 pp.4–5，§3；RQ2/RQ3 使用用户指定的等义简写，保留原报告完整含义。
notes:
第8页 / Slide 8: Research aim and three questions
主讲参考时长 / Reference time: 50 s

中文逐字稿
研究目标是实现并评价一个证据可追溯的 RAG 问答系统。三个问题分别对应三个模块：RQ1 比较 BM25、Dense 和 Hybrid，检验混合检索是否提高证据召回；RQ2 检验版本过滤能否减少使用非请求版本的回答；RQ3 检验 Evidence Gate 能否减少无依据回答，同时避免过度拒答。它们都是待验证的问题，不能预先写成“Hybrid 一定更好”或“门控能够消除幻觉”。预期贡献主要是可追溯语料与题集、受控比较，以及对失败原因的分析。

English Script
The aim is to implement and evaluate a traceable RAG question-answering system. Three questions correspond to three modules. RQ1 compares BM25, Dense and Hybrid to test whether fusion improves evidence recall. RQ2 asks whether edition filtering reduces answers using a non-requested edition. RQ3 asks whether an Evidence Gate reduces unsupported answers without excessive refusal. These remain open questions: Hybrid is not assumed to perform better, and the gate cannot be assumed to eliminate hallucinations. The intended contributions are a traceable corpus and benchmark, controlled comparisons, and failure analysis.

来源 / Sources
报告 pp.4–5，§3；RQ2/RQ3 使用用户指定的等义简写，保留原报告完整含义。

title: System architecture
chinese: 技术路线可以概括为先找依据，再组织回答。计划解析许可使用的PDF和DOCX，分块并保存版本与来源位置。提问后限定标准系列和版本，再用BM25、Dense或Hybrid检索。Evidence Gate通过词项覆盖率或原始余弦相似度作启发式筛选；通过后交给DeepSeek生成回答，由Streamlit展示引用。Gate不能证明语义正确，数值、单位和适用条件仍需人工评分验证。
english: The workflow is to find evidence before generating an answer. We will parse licensed PDF and DOCX files, preserving edition metadata and source locations. Queries will be filtered by standard family and edition, then retrieved using BM25, Dense, or Hybrid. An Evidence Gate will screen passages using term coverage or raw cosine similarity. DeepSeek will generate an answer, and Streamlit will display citations. The gate is heuristic, not proof of semantic correctness; human scoring will check values, units, and applicability conditions.
source: 报告 pp.5–7，§4.1–4.4，Fig.4-1；本页原生可编辑图为报告流程的重新排版。
notes:
第9页 / Slide 9: System architecture
主讲参考时长 / Reference time: 65 s

中文逐字稿
整体流程分为文档准备和在线查询。首先，对许可使用的 PDF、DOCX 做解析与分块，保存标准编号、年份、哈希和位置，再建立 SQLite 记录及检索索引。查询进入后，结合有限规则处理追问，并确定标准系列和版本约束。接着使用三种检索方式之一获得候选证据。Evidence Gate 根据词项覆盖率或原始余弦相似度进行筛选。通过后，才将获准发送的证据交给 DeepSeek，并进行引用编号和摘录检查；不通过则拒答。版本缺失或有歧义，也进入拒答或澄清分支。最后，Streamlit 展示回答及原文位置。自动检查主要保证结构与出处一致，语义支持仍需人工评价。

English Script
The workflow separates document preparation from online queries. Permitted PDFs and DOCX files will be parsed and chunked, retaining identifiers, years, hashes and source locations. SQLite records and retrieval indexes will then be built. Queries will use limited rules for follow-ups and establish family and edition constraints. One of the three retrieval methods will return candidate evidence. The Evidence Gate will screen it using lexical coverage or raw cosine similarity. Accepted evidence, where authorised for external processing, will go to DeepSeek, followed by citation-identifier and excerpt checks. Rejected evidence leads to refusal. Missing or ambiguous editions also trigger refusal or clarification. Finally, Streamlit will display the answer and source locations. Automatic checks address structure and provenance; semantic support still requires human assessment.

来源 / Sources
报告 pp.5–7，§4.1–4.4，Fig.4-1；本页原生可编辑图为报告流程的重新排版。

title: Benchmark and controlled experiments
chinese: 计划收集二十到三十份可用文档，尽可能覆盖两个标准系列，每个系列两个正式版本。人工校核一百道题：二十道开发题，其中十六道可回答、四道不可回答；八十道测试题，其中六十四道可回答、十六道不可回答。五组配置是B1 BM25、B2 Dense、B3 Hybrid，以及关闭版本检查的A1和关闭Gate的A2。A1仍保留标准系列过滤；A2仍保留提示词、引用校验和错误处理。测试前冻结数据和设置，计划执行八十乘五，共四百次。
english: We plan to collect twenty to thirty usable documents, ideally two standard families with two formal editions each. One hundred manually checked questions are split into twenty development questions, sixteen answerable and four unanswerable, and eighty test questions, sixty-four answerable and sixteen unanswerable. We compare B1 BM25, B2 Dense, B3 Hybrid, A1 without edition checks, and A2 without the gate. A1 retains family filtering; A2 retains prompts, citation validation, and error handling. Data and settings are frozen before the planned four hundred test runs.
source: 报告 pp.4–7，O3–O4、§4.5；严格 A1/A2 契约见备份第22页。
notes:
第13页 / Slide 13: Benchmark and controlled experiments
主讲参考时长 / Reference time: 65 s

中文逐字稿
计划建立一百道人工校核题。二十道用于开发，其中十六道可回答、四道不可回答；八十道用于正式测试，其中六十四道可回答、十六道不可回答。题目记录原文证据、版本、事实和条件，相关事实或对话放在同一个划分中，避免泄漏。正式测试共有五组：B1 是 BM25，B2 是 Dense，B3 是 Hybrid；A1 在 Hybrid 上关闭版本检查，但保留标准系列过滤；A2 只关闭 Evidence Gate，保留提示词、引用校验和错误处理。所有组共享冻结的数据和生成设置，所以主要测试是八十乘五，四百次计划执行，而不是已经完成的结果。

English Script
The planned benchmark contains one hundred manually checked questions. Twenty are for development: sixteen answerable and four unanswerable. Eighty are for formal testing: sixty-four answerable and sixteen unanswerable. Records will include source evidence, editions, facts and conditions. Related facts or dialogues will stay within one split to prevent leakage. Five configurations will be tested: B1 uses BM25, B2 Dense, and B3 Hybrid. A1 disables edition checks in Hybrid but retains family filtering. A2 disables only the Evidence Gate, retaining prompts, citation validation and error handling. All groups share frozen data and generation settings. The main test therefore comprises eighty times five, or four hundred planned executions, not completed results.

来源 / Sources
报告 pp.4–7，O3–O4、§4.5；严格 A1/A2 契约见备份第22页。

title: Evaluation metrics and planned targets
chinese: 评价同时检查检索和回答。Recall@5看前五条是否召回证据；Answer Correctness和Citation Support由人工判断；Wrong-edition Rate检查版本错误。Refusal Recall和False Refusal分别衡量该拒答时是否拒答，以及可回答时是否误拒。页面中的零点八、零点九等数值都是计划目标，没有现有测试结果支撑。
english: Recall at five evaluates evidence retrieval. Human scoring evaluates answer correctness and citation support. Wrong-edition rate measures edition errors. Refusal recall measures appropriate refusal, while false refusal measures rejected answerable questions. Values such as point eight and point nine are planned targets, not measured results.
source: 报告 pp.6–7，§4.5；严格指标分母、零分母 N/A 规则及补充指标见备份第16–17页。
notes:
第14页 / Slide 14: Evaluation metrics and planned targets
主讲参考时长 / Reference time: 55 s

中文逐字稿
评价分为检索、回答与拒答。Recall@5 使用六十四道可回答测试题的门控前排名；Answer Correctness 只有完全正确才得分。Citation Support 判断被引用的声明是否得到证据支持，还要同时报告引用覆盖率。Wrong-edition Rate 统计非请求版本，并按版本是否可用分层，避免靠大量拒答掩盖问题。Refusal Recall 看不可回答题是否得到合理拒答，False Refusal 则惩罚可回答题上的拒答或不必要澄清。页面上的零点八、零点九和零点一全部是计划目标。API 或格式失败仍算错误，不能作为合理拒答；结果会同时报告计数、差异、覆盖率和不确定性。

English Script
Evaluation covers retrieval, answers and refusal. Recall at five uses pre-gate rankings for all sixty-four answerable test items. Answer Correctness credits only fully correct answers. Citation Support assesses whether cited claims are supported, alongside citation coverage. Wrong-edition Rate tracks non-requested editions and is stratified by availability, so excessive refusal cannot conceal the problem. Refusal Recall measures justified non-answering on unanswerable items; False Refusal penalises refusal or unnecessary clarification on answerable items. The displayed values of zero point eight, zero point nine and zero point one are planning targets. API and format failures remain errors, not justified refusals. Results will include counts, differences, coverage and uncertainty.

来源 / Sources
报告 pp.6–7，§4.5；严格指标分母、零分母 N/A 规则及补充指标见备份第16–17页。

title: Feasibility and key risks
chinese: 可行性上，计划采用现有RAG组件，并把范围限定在许可文档查询。主要风险是正式版本不足和Gate误判：前者必要时缩小RQ2范围，后者通过开发集与人工评估报告误接受和误拒答。这里不预设系统已经实现或达到目标。
english: The plan uses established RAG components within a bounded document-consultation task. The main risks are insufficient formal editions and gate errors. We will narrow RQ2 if necessary, and report false acceptance and refusal through development-set calibration and human evaluation. Implementation and target performance remain to be verified.
source: docs/progress_journal/evidence/week09/README.md E09-03/E09-04（2026-11-04）；报告 §4.6。仅为该日快照，不推定此后新增完成情况。
notes:

English Script
Current evidence supports only limited feasibility. The fourth-of-November record shows a three-document BM25 prototype, five hundred and three chunks, and zero vectors. DeepSeek checks used synthetic evidence; they do not establish success on real standards queries. Live Embedding access, Dense and Hybrid effectiveness, and formal benchmark evaluation remain unconfirmed. Next, I will prioritise service access and corpus permissions, followed by development validation. Two key risks are insufficient formal edition pairs and incorrect gate decisions. The first may limit RQ2 conclusions; the second must be reported through controlled comparisons and human scoring.

title: Backup: data risks and fallback scope
chinese: 备用页：目标为二十至三十份许可使用的文档，尽可能取得两个系列、各两个正式版本。用哈希去重，用正文与元数据核对版本及位置；扫描件、草稿和不合格抽取不充数。若版对不足，保持 A1 并把 RQ2 限于可支持的案例。若 Embedding 不可用，记录失败、解决接口，保留本地检索作为有限交付；若换提供商，记录变更并统一重做受影响比较，不能混合有利输出。外发文本先核对许可，保护凭据与测试标签。Week 22–23 为计划休息，Week 25–27 准备 viva。
english: Backup: target 20–30 permitted documents and seek two standard families with two formal editions each. Deduplicate by hash and verify edition identity and source locations against document content and metadata. Do not count scans, drafts or failed extraction as usable editions. If edition pairs remain insufficient, retain A1 and limit RQ2 to supported cases. If Embedding access fails, record the failure and resolve access. Local retrieval remains a limited deliverable; it does not validate Dense, Hybrid or online QA. If a provider changes, document it and rerun all affected comparisons consistently rather than combining favourable outputs. Check permission before sending text externally, and protect credentials and test labels. Weeks 22–23 are a planned break; Weeks 25–27 cover viva preparation and examination.
